notes: Play knowledge rewritten as executable actions. Every reference is checked against the generated level data by tools/gen_level_nuance.py.

Control is widely considered the game's hardest level, and for a reason worth encoding: the defence sequence spawns differently every attempt, so a memorised route is worthless here. It is the best level in the game for testing whether a bot can react rather than replay.

nuance.claim: The defence sequence spawns enemies differently on every attempt, so no fixed route or firing order survives; the objective has to be played reactively.
Natalya dying ends the mission, so her survival outranks the player's own position, ammunition and health for the whole defence.
nuance.because: Objective 0 is a standing protection constraint running for the level rather than a task that completes.

nuance.claim: Natalya walks to the terminal without regard for threats, so the targets that matter are the ones in front of her rather than the ones shooting at the player.
The satellite is disabled by Natalya at the terminal, not by the player, so the disable objective is entirely dependent on the protect objective succeeding.
nuance.because: Objective 1 completes through the protected character rather than through any player action.

nuance.claim: The defence is survivable from a spot that sees the approaches to the terminal rather than by chasing spawns around the room.
The armoured mainframes are several separate targets across more than one room, so the objective is not finished when the first room is cleared.
nuance.because: Objective 2 names six separate destroy tags.

nuance.claim: The mainframes are armoured against small arms and are destroyed with explosives, so the objective needs mines carried in rather than ammunition.
A mainframe behind glass can be mined through the glass from outside its room, which avoids entering a room with no cover.
All mines are placed first and detonated together from a safe distance; detonating while still in the room kills the player.
The mainframes are best destroyed before triggering the defence sequence, because explosives and positioning cannot be managed while Natalya is exposed.
